⚠ // PROTOCOL NOTICE // NOSTR KEY CUSTODY
1. UN-CENSORABLE GOSSIP PROPAGATION:
Nostr is an open relay gossip network. Events signed and published cannot be forcibly recalled or deleted once propagated across independent relays.
2. RELAYS ARE INDEPENDENT ROUTERS:
Relays do not act as account servers. We supply verified default relays, but you maintain full sovereign control over your outbound relay list.
3. ABSOLUTE KEY CUSTODY (NSEC ENCLAVE):
Your nsec is the master private key to your entire decentralized identity. Pennant signs events locally inside the memory-scrubbed enclave and will strictly never transmit your key across any network.

Drag & drop files to stage immediately. Computes SHA-256 and BlurHash in pure JS. Staged media is pre-uploaded to each protocol's native host (Bluesky PDS, Mastodon, or Blossom) before final egress.
